cc:Work.dc:title: golden-state-winning-margins
cc:Work.dc:description: Golden State scoring margin versus Atlanta. Game 1: points off turnovers +9, all other points −5, final margin +4. Game 4: points off turnovers +8, all other points −3, final margin +5. This is score accounting, not a causal estimate.
